comments.author: Jan Bessai
comments.markdown:
This is rather old, but apo and g\_apo need a small fix:  
\> apo psi = h .Right where h = InF . fmap h . (fmap Left . outF ||| psi)  
\> g\_apo g f = h .Right where h = InF . fmap h . (fmap Left . g ||| f)  
otherwise they will not typecheck.

comments.author: JanBessai
comments.markdown:
The type signature of strength’ needs to be flipped  
\> strength’ :: Functor f => f a -> t -> f (t, a)
